summary: Discover effective strategies for managing water resources in rural areas. Enroll in our comprehensive training course and empower your community today!
lede: Rural water resource management focuses on planning reliable, safe and sustainable services beyond building infrastructure. For rural water officers, WASH staff, community water leaders and project teams, the course covers assessing sources and demand, planning water safety and maintenance, and supporting fair allocation and accountable governance.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals working in or with rural water systems across various sectors. It's tailored for those who are responsible for ensuring reliable, safe, and sustainable water access in rural communities.
audience: County/government water officers and rural WASH staff
NGO program managers and WASH coordinators
Community water committee leaders and operators
Climate resilience and livelihoods program staff
modules: Principles of Rural Water Resource Management
Understanding Rural Water Demand and Use
Water Quality and Water Safety Planning
Rural Water Infrastructure and Service Reliability
Financing, Tariffs, and Budgeting for Sustainability
Climate Risk, Drought Preparedness, and Resilience
Monitoring, Data, and Reporting for Better Decisions
prerequisites: Participants should have basic knowledge of water systems and a role related to water resource management in rural settings. Familiarity with community engagement will be beneficial.
